focus.title: Focus Adjustment
focus.hazard: At {{obj}}× magnification, depth of field is shallow—use Fine Focus for small adjustments and avoid coarse sweeps to prevent slide/objective contact.

diagram.title: Microscope Parts
diagram.footer: Click objective to cycle magnification or <lamp>lamp</lamp> to toggle power.

slideTray.title: Prepared Slide Tray (Click to mount specimen)

text-slide.subtitle: Text Slide
text-slide.name: Text Slide
text-slide.description: This is a text slide. It contains a short paragraph of text that can be read under the microscope.

onion-root-tip.subtitle: Mitosis Stages
onion-root-tip.name: Onion Root Tip
onion-root-tip.description: This slide shows the root tip of an onion. You can observe cells undergoing mitosis, including prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase.

human-blood-smear.subtitle: RBCs, WBCs & Platelets
human-blood-smear.name: Human Blood Smear
human-blood-smear.description: This slide shows a smear of human blood. You can observe red blood cells (RBCs), white blood cells (WBCs), and platelets.

pond-water-live.subtitle: Live Microorganisms
pond-water-live.name: Pond Water (Live)
pond-water-live.description: This slide contains a sample of pond water. You can observe live microorganisms such as protozoa and algae swimming around.

leaf-epidermis.subtitle: Guard Cells & Stomata
leaf-epidermis.name: Leaf Epidermis
leaf-epidermis.description: This slide shows the epidermis of a leaf. You can observe guard cells and stomata, which are responsible for gas exchange in plants.

viewport.oilWarning: 100× Oil Immersion objective requires immersion oil drop (n = 1.515)
